If you need a kynect Marketplace plan instead (income above Medicaid limit), pregnancy triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period.

quickAnswer.en: Pregnant women in Kentucky can apply for Kentucky Medicaid year-round with no deadline. Kentucky covers pregnancy Medicaid at 213% of the Federal Poverty Level, which equals approximately $33,995 for a single pregnant woman or $70,290 for a family of 4 in 2026. Kentucky is a Medicaid expansion state, and postpartum Medicaid coverage extends 12 months after birth. If your income exceeds the 213% FPL pregnancy Medicaid limit, a kynect Marketplace plan covers maternity as an essential health benefit, and pregnancy is a qualifying life event that opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period. KCHIP covers children in Kentucky households earning too much for Medicaid. Apply at kynect.ky.gov or call 1-855-459-6328.
quickAnswer.es: Las mujeres embarazadas en Kentucky pueden solicitar Medicaid de Kentucky todo el ano sin fecha limite. Kentucky cubre Medicaid de embarazo al 213% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, lo que equivale a aproximadamente $33,995 para una mujer embarazada sola o $70,290 para una familia de 4 en 2026. Kentucky es un estado con expansion de Medicaid, y la cobertura postparto de Medicaid se extiende 12 meses despues del parto. Si sus ingresos superan el limite del 213% FPL, un plan del mercado kynect cubre la maternidad como beneficio esencial de salud, y el embarazo es un evento calificador de vida que abre un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias. KCHIP cubre a los ninos en hogares de Kentucky que ganan demasiado para Medicaid.

introParagraphs.en: Kentucky Medicaid is one of the strongest safety nets for pregnant women in the country, and the rules work in your favor in 2026. Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA in 2014, meaning all adults up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level qualify for standard Medicaid regardless of pregnancy status. But pregnancy unlocks a separate, more generous eligibility category: Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers incomes up to 213% FPL, well above the standard expansion limit. For a single pregnant woman in 2026, that threshold is approximately $33,995 per year. For a household of 4, the limit rises to approximately $70,290. The unborn child typically counts as an additional household member under Kentucky Medicaid rules, which pushes your household size up by one and further increases the income ceiling in your favor. Kentucky also has strong coverage duration: postpartum Medicaid extends 12 months after delivery for any woman enrolled during pregnancy, which is the federal maximum under provisions of the American Rescue Plan Act made permanent in 2023. Enrollment is open year-round through kynect.ky.gov, Kentucky's integrated benefits portal, or through medicaid.gov. Kentucky also offers Presumptive Eligibility for pregnant women, meaning a hospital, prenatal clinic, or federally qualified health center can authorize temporary Medicaid coverage within days while the full application is reviewed.
introParagraphs.es: Kentucky Medicaid es una de las redes de seguridad mas solidas para las mujeres embarazadas en el pais, y las reglas funcionan a su favor en 2026. Kentucky expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA en 2014, lo que significa que todos los adultos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza califican para Medicaid estandar independientemente del estado de embarazo. Pero el embarazo desbloquea una categoria de elegibilidad separada y mas generosa: Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas cubre ingresos hasta el 213% FPL. Para una mujer embarazada sola en 2026, ese umbral es aproximadamente $33,995 por ano. Para un hogar de 4, el limite sube a aproximadamente $70,290. El feto generalmente cuenta como un miembro adicional del hogar bajo las reglas de Medicaid de Kentucky, lo que aumenta su tamano del hogar en uno y eleva aun mas el techo de ingresos. La cobertura postparto de Medicaid se extiende 12 meses despues del parto para cualquier mujer inscrita durante el embarazo. La inscripcion esta abierta todo el ano a traves de kynect.ky.gov.

introParagraphs.en: Three coverage pathways serve pregnant women in Kentucky in 2026. Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers incomes up to 213% FPL with zero premiums, zero deductibles, and zero cost-sharing for delivery in most cases. KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children in Kentucky families earning too much for Medicaid but still at lower income levels, typically up to 218% FPL for children, and operates year-round with no deadline. The kynect Marketplace is the third pathway: for pregnant women whose income exceeds the Medicaid pregnancy limit, kynect Marketplace plans are required to cover maternity care as an essential health benefit, and premium tax credits apply for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL in 2026. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff returned for the current plan year, meaning tax credits are available between 100% and 400% FPL and incomes above 400% FPL face unsubsidized premiums. A hospital birth without Medicaid in Kentucky can generate bills up to the 2026 ACA out-of-pocket maximum of $10,600 per individual, making the Medicaid eligibility check the most valuable first step any pregnant woman in Kentucky can take before comparing kynect plans. Check the Medicaid income limits page to see whether your household income falls under Kentucky's 213% FPL threshold before enrolling in a paid plan.
introParagraphs.es: Tres vias de cobertura sirven a las mujeres embarazadas en Kentucky en 2026. Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas cubre ingresos hasta el 213% FPL con cero primas, cero deducibles y cero costos compartidos para el parto en la mayoria de los casos. KCHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos de Kentucky) cubre a los ninos en familias de Kentucky que ganan demasiado para Medicaid, tipicamente hasta el 218% FPL para ninos, y opera todo el ano sin fecha limite. El Mercado kynect es la tercera via: para mujeres embarazadas cuyos ingresos superan el limite de Medicaid de embarazo, los planes del mercado kynect deben cubrir la atencion de maternidad como beneficio esencial de salud, y los creditos fiscales de prima aplican para ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL en 2026. Una factura del hospital por parto sin Medicaid en Kentucky puede generar cargos hasta el maximo de gastos de bolsillo ACA 2026 de $10,600 por persona. Verifique los limites de ingresos de Medicaid para ver si los ingresos de su hogar caen bajo el umbral del 213% FPL de Kentucky antes de inscribirse en un plan de pago.

en: Proof of pregnancy: signed letter or document from a licensed physician, nurse practitioner, or certified nurse midwife confirming pregnancy and estimated due date (required for both Kentucky Medicaid and kynect Marketplace SEP)
Proof of Kentucky residency: utility bill, lease agreement, bank statement, or official mail addressed to you in Kentucky with your current address
Proof of identity: government-issued photo ID (driver's license, Kentucky state ID, or passport)

Proof of citizenship or immigration status: US birth certificate or US passport for citizens; green card, visa, or employment authorization card for lawfully present immigrants (who qualify for Kentucky Medicaid for pregnancy in most cases)
Social Security numbers for yourself and every household member applying
Proof of income: last 30 days of pay stubs, employer letter stating your wage rate, most recent federal tax return (Form 1040), or written statement of no income if currently unemployed

Information on any other health coverage you currently have: insurance card, COBRA notice, or employer benefits letter (needed to document qualifying event for kynect SEP if applying for Marketplace plan instead of Medicaid)
Birth certificates for any existing children you are adding to KCHIP
es: Prueba de embarazo: carta firmada o documento de un medico, enfermera practicante o partera certificada con licencia que confirme el embarazo y la fecha estimada de parto
Prueba de residencia en Kentucky: factura de servicios, contrato de arrendamiento, estado de cuenta bancario o correspondencia oficial dirigida a usted en Kentucky con su direccion actual
Prueba de identidad: identificacion con foto emitida por el gobierno (licencia de conducir, identificacion estatal de Kentucky o pasaporte)

Prueba de ciudadania o estado migratorio: acta de nacimiento de EE.UU. o pasaporte para ciudadanos; tarjeta de residencia, visa o tarjeta de autorizacion de empleo para inmigrantes legalmente presentes
Numeros de Seguro Social para usted y todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan

Prueba de ingresos: talones de pago de los ultimos 30 dias, carta del empleador indicando su tarifa salarial, declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente (Formulario 1040) o declaracion escrita de no ingresos si esta desempleada actualmente
Informacion sobre cualquier otra cobertura de salud que tenga actualmente: tarjeta de seguro, aviso COBRA o carta de beneficios del empleador
Certificados de nacimiento para los hijos existentes que agrega a KCHIP

en: Applying to kynect Marketplace before checking Kentucky Medicaid: pregnancy Medicaid in Kentucky is free, covers delivery with zero cost-sharing in most cases, and the income limit of 213% FPL ($33,995 for a single person in 2026) is generous enough that most pregnant Kentucky women qualify; Marketplace plans cost money even with subsidies

Miscounting household size: Kentucky Medicaid counts the unborn child as a household member starting from pregnancy, making a pregnant woman alone a household of 2 for eligibility purposes; applying as a household of 1 can result in incorrect income percentage calculation and an avoidable denial

Missing the 60-day kynect Marketplace SEP window: for women who do not qualify for Medicaid and need a Marketplace plan, the pregnancy SEP application must be submitted within 60 days of the qualifying event; applications submitted after Day 60 are rejected outside Open Enrollment

Reporting prior-year income instead of projected current-year income: Kentucky Medicaid uses current monthly income annualized, while kynect Marketplace uses projected 2026 MAGI; reporting last year's W-2 income when this year's income has dropped can result in an incorrect denial

Assuming immigration status disqualifies: lawfully present immigrants, including green card holders and many visa categories, qualify for Kentucky pregnancy Medicaid; emergency Medicaid covers labor and delivery for anyone regardless of immigration status; do not assume ineligibility before applying
es: Solicitar al mercado kynect antes de verificar Medicaid de Kentucky: Medicaid de embarazo en Kentucky es gratuito, cubre el parto sin costos compartidos en la mayoria de los casos, y el limite de ingresos del 213% FPL ($33,995 para una sola persona en 2026) es lo suficientemente generoso como para que la mayoria de las mujeres embarazadas de Kentucky califiquen

Contar mal el tamano del hogar: Medicaid de Kentucky cuenta al feto como miembro del hogar desde el embarazo, haciendo que una mujer embarazada sola sea un hogar de 2 para propositos de elegibilidad; aplicar como hogar de 1 puede resultar en un calculo incorrecto del porcentaje de ingresos

Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias del mercado kynect: para mujeres que no califican para Medicaid y necesitan un plan del Mercado, la solicitud de SEP de embarazo debe presentarse dentro de 60 dias del evento calificador

Reportar ingresos del ano anterior en lugar de ingresos proyectados del ano actual: Medicaid de Kentucky usa los ingresos mensuales actuales anualizados, mientras que kynect Marketplace usa el MAGI proyectado de 2026

Asumir que el estado migratorio descalifica: los inmigrantes legalmente presentes, incluidos los titulares de tarjeta de residencia y muchas categorias de visa, califican para Medicaid de embarazo de Kentucky; el Medicaid de emergencia cubre el parto para cualquier persona independientemente del estado migratorio

stateRules.rule: Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers income up to 213% FPL in 2026. The unborn child counts as a household member, raising the applicable income threshold. Kentucky adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension under the ARP, effective April 2022. Applications go through kynect.ky.gov or the Cabinet for Health and Family Services (CHFS).

Kentucky offers Presumptive Eligibility (PE) for pregnant women. Qualified entities including hospitals, prenatal clinics, and Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) can grant temporary Medicaid coverage within days while the full application is reviewed by the Cabinet for Health and Family Services.

KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children in Kentucky households earning too much for Medicaid, typically up to 218% FPL for children through age 18. KCHIP is administered by the Cabinet for Health and Family Services and enrolls year-round with no deadline.

Kentucky is a Medicaid expansion state (expanded January 1, 2014). All Kentucky adults without children earning up to 138% FPL qualify for Kentucky Medicaid. Pregnant women qualify at the higher 213% FPL threshold under the separate pregnancy Medicaid category.

kynect is Kentucky's official integrated benefits portal for Medicaid, KCHIP, and kynect Marketplace (ACA) plan enrollment. Applications for all three programs are accepted at kynect.ky.gov. Phone applications are available at 1-855-459-6328.

heading.en: Kentucky Medicaid vs. kynect Marketplace vs. COBRA: Which Covers Pregnancy Best in 2026?
heading.es: Medicaid de Kentucky vs. Mercado kynect vs. COBRA: Cual Cubre Mejor el Embarazo en 2026?

body.en: Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women is the clear first choice for most pregnant women in the state because it combines the most generous income threshold (213% FPL) with zero cost-sharing at delivery in most cases, year-round enrollment with no deadline, and the 12-month postpartum extension now in effect for Kentucky. A family of 4 earning up to $70,290 in 2026 qualifies. Kentucky Medicaid covers all prenatal visits, lab work, ultrasounds, labor and delivery, and 12 months of postpartum care with no deductible. Newborns born to Medicaid-enrolled mothers in Kentucky are automatically deemed eligible for Medicaid for their first year under the federal deemed newborn rule, with no separate application required. kynect Marketplace plans are the fallback for pregnant women whose income exceeds the 213% FPL Kentucky Medicaid limit. Pregnancy is a qualifying life event under ACA rules, triggering a 60-day Special Enrollment Period at kynect.ky.gov. All kynect Marketplace plans cover maternity care as an essential health benefit, with preventive prenatal visits at zero cost-sharing. The trade-off: kynect Marketplace plans carry deductibles and out-of-pocket exposure up to $10,600 per individual (the 2026 ACA Marketplace OOP maximum), plus monthly premiums even after premium tax credits. For incomes between 100% and 400% FPL, premium tax credits in 2026 reduce costs significantly, but the 2026 subsidy cliff has returned for the current plan year, meaning incomes above 400% FPL face unsubsidized premiums. COBRA continuation is the most expensive option for pregnant women in Kentucky. COBRA charges 102% of the full employer premium, typically $700 to $2,000 per month for an individual, and provides no benefit not already available more cheaply through Kentucky Medicaid or a subsidized kynect plan. The one scenario where COBRA makes sense during pregnancy: you are actively mid-pregnancy with a specific OB-GYN or maternal-fetal medicine specialist not in any kynect Marketplace network, and you have already met a significant portion of your deductible for the year. In that scenario, COBRA preserves network continuity for the remainder of the calendar year.
body.es: Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas es la primera opcion clara para la mayoria de las mujeres embarazadas en el estado porque combina el umbral de ingresos mas generoso (213% FPL) con cero costos compartidos en el parto en la mayoria de los casos, inscripcion todo el ano sin fecha limite, y la extension postparto de 12 meses ahora vigente en Kentucky. Una familia de 4 que gana hasta $70,290 en 2026 califica. Los recien nacidos nacidos de madres inscritas en Medicaid en Kentucky son automaticamente considerados elegibles para Medicaid por su primer ano bajo la regla federal del recien nacido presunto. Los planes del mercado kynect son la alternativa para mujeres embarazadas cuyos ingresos superan el limite del 213% FPL de Medicaid de Kentucky. Los planes kynect cubren la atencion de maternidad como beneficio esencial con visitas prenatales preventivas sin costo compartido. La contrapartida: los planes kynect tienen deducibles y exposicion de gastos de bolsillo hasta $10,600 por persona, mas primas mensuales incluso despues de los creditos fiscales. COBRA es la opcion mas cara para las mujeres embarazadas en Kentucky y rara vez tiene sentido frente a Medicaid o un plan kynect subsidiado.

name.en: Calculate your income and household size under Kentucky Medicaid rules
name.es: Calcule sus ingresos y tamano del hogar bajo las reglas de Medicaid de Kentucky

text.en: Count the unborn child as a member of your household. Kentucky Medicaid uses this rule, so a pregnant woman applying alone is effectively a household of 2. Use your projected 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI), not last year's income. If Kentucky Medicaid's 213% FPL threshold covers your income (approximately $33,995 for a single person or $70,290 for a family of 4 in 2026), Medicaid is your best option. Check the income table on this page and verify at kynect.ky.gov.
text.es: Cuente al feto como miembro de su hogar. Medicaid de Kentucky usa esta regla, por lo que una mujer embarazada que solicita sola es efectivamente un hogar de 2. Use su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para 2026, no el ingreso del ano pasado. Si el umbral del 213% FPL de Medicaid de Kentucky cubre sus ingresos (aproximadamente $33,995 para una persona sola o $70,290 para una familia de 4 en 2026), Medicaid es su mejor opcion. Verifique en kynect.ky.gov.

name.en: Apply for Kentucky Medicaid immediately at kynect.ky.gov
name.es: Solicite Medicaid de Kentucky de inmediato en kynect.ky.gov

text.en: Submit your application at kynect.ky.gov or call 1-855-459-6328. Kentucky Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no deadline for pregnant women. Ask about Presumptive Eligibility: a hospital, prenatal clinic, or federally qualified health center in Kentucky can authorize temporary Medicaid coverage within days while the Cabinet for Health and Family Services processes your full application. Early application ensures your first prenatal visit, lab work, and ultrasounds are covered from the earliest possible date.
text.es: Envie su solicitud en kynect.ky.gov o llame al 1-855-459-6328. La inscripcion en Medicaid de Kentucky es todo el ano sin fecha limite para mujeres embarazadas. Pregunte sobre la Elegibilidad Presuntiva: un hospital, clinica prenatal o centro de salud calificado federalmente en Kentucky puede autorizar cobertura temporal de Medicaid en dias mientras el Gabinete de Salud y Servicios Familiares procesa su solicitud completa.

name.en: Gather required documents before your appointment
name.es: Reuna los documentos necesarios antes de su cita

text.en: Collect a letter from your Kentucky doctor or midwife confirming pregnancy and estimated due date, proof of income (pay stubs from the past 30 days or self-employment records), proof of Kentucky residency (utility bill or lease in your name), your Social Security number, and proof of identity. For non-citizens, bring immigration documents. Lawfully present immigrants, including green card holders, qualify for Kentucky pregnancy Medicaid under federal Medicaid rules.
text.es: Reuna una carta de su medico o partera de Kentucky que confirme el embarazo y la fecha estimada de parto, prueba de ingresos (talones de pago de los ultimos 30 dias o registros de trabajo por cuenta propia), prueba de residencia en Kentucky (factura de servicios o contrato de arrendamiento a su nombre), su numero de Seguro Social y prueba de identidad. Los inmigrantes legalmente presentes, incluidos los titulares de tarjeta de residencia, califican para Medicaid de embarazo de Kentucky.

name.en: If income exceeds 213% FPL, enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan within 60 days
name.es: Si el ingreso supera el 213% FPL, inscribase en un plan del mercado kynect dentro de 60 dias

text.en: Pregnancy is a qualifying life event that triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for kynect Marketplace plans. Log in at kynect.ky.gov and select a plan that includes your OB-GYN in-network. All kynect plans cover maternity care as an essential health benefit with zero cost-sharing for preventive prenatal visits. Use your projected 2026 household income to calculate premium tax credits: credits apply for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL under the 2026 ACA rules. Apply within 60 days of confirming your pregnancy to avoid waiting until November Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage.
text.es: El embarazo es un evento calificador de vida que activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del mercado kynect. Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov y seleccione un plan que incluya a su ginecoologo en la red. Todos los planes kynect cubren la atencion de maternidad como beneficio esencial con cero costo compartido para visitas prenatales preventivas. Use sus ingresos proyectados del hogar para 2026 para calcular los creditos fiscales de prima: los creditos aplican para ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL bajo las reglas ACA 2026.

name.en: Check KCHIP eligibility for your existing children
name.es: Verifique la elegibilidad de KCHIP para sus hijos existentes

text.en: KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children in Kentucky households earning too much for Medicaid but still at lower incomes, typically up to 218% FPL for children through age 18. KCHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply at kynect.ky.gov simultaneously with your pregnancy Medicaid application. KCHIP premiums are very low or free, and coverage includes well-child visits, dental, and vision.
text.es: KCHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos de Kentucky) cubre a los ninos en hogares de Kentucky que ganan demasiado para Medicaid, tipicamente hasta el 218% FPL para ninos hasta los 18 anos. La inscripcion en KCHIP es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Solicite en kynect.ky.gov simultaneamente con su solicitud de Medicaid de embarazo.

name.en: Confirm Kentucky's 12-month postpartum Medicaid coverage and plan the transition
name.es: Confirme la cobertura postparto Medicaid de 12 meses de Kentucky y planifique la transicion

text.en: Kentucky adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension under the American Rescue Plan Act. Ask your Kentucky Medicaid caseworker to confirm your postpartum coverage period. After the 12-month postpartum period ends, standard Kentucky Medicaid income rules apply at 138% FPL. If your income exceeds that threshold, losing Medicaid triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for kynect Marketplace plans. Compare ACA income limits before your postpartum coverage ends to plan your transition.
text.es: Kentucky adopto la extension de Medicaid postparto de 12 meses bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano. Pregunte a su trabajador de casos de Medicaid de Kentucky para confirmar su periodo de cobertura postparto. Despues de que termine el periodo postparto de 12 meses, se aplican las reglas estandar de ingresos de Medicaid de Kentucky al 138% FPL. Si sus ingresos superan ese umbral, perder Medicaid activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del mercado kynect.

name.en: Notify the Kentucky Cabinet for Health and Family Services of your newborn's birth
name.es: Notifique al Gabinete de Salud y Servicios Familiares de Kentucky del nacimiento de su recien nacido

text.en: Babies born to Kentucky Medicaid-enrolled mothers on the date of delivery are automatically deemed eligible for Medicaid through their first birthday under the federal deemed newborn rule (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No separate application is required for the baby. Notify the Cabinet for Health and Family Services (CHFS) at kynect.ky.gov or by calling 1-855-459-6328 with the baby's name and birth date within 60 days to finalize the enrollment record. The baby's deemed Medicaid enrollment covers the full birth hospitalization and all well-baby care through the first birthday.
text.es: Los bebes nacidos de madres inscritas en Medicaid de Kentucky el dia del parto son automaticamente considerados elegibles para Medicaid hasta su primer cumpleanos bajo la regla federal del recien nacido presunto (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No se requiere solicitud separada para el bebe. Notifique al Gabinete de Salud y Servicios Familiares (CHFS) en kynect.ky.gov o llamando al 1-855-459-6328 con el nombre y fecha de nacimiento del bebe dentro de 60 dias.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes pregnant women in Kentucky make when seeking coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen las mujeres embarazadas en Kentucky al buscar cobertura en 2026:

items.en: Skipping the Kentucky Medicaid check and going straight to kynect Marketplace. Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers up to 213% FPL in 2026 with zero cost-sharing at delivery. Most pregnant Kentucky women who enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan instead of Medicaid end up paying deductibles and premiums they never had to pay.
items.es: Omitir la verificacion de Medicaid de Kentucky e ir directamente al mercado kynect. Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas cubre hasta el 213% FPL en 2026 con cero costos compartidos en el parto. La mayoria de las mujeres embarazadas de Kentucky que se inscriben en un plan del mercado kynect en lugar de Medicaid terminan pagando deducibles y primas que nunca tuvieron que pagar.

items.en: Applying as a household of 1 when the unborn child should be counted. Kentucky Medicaid counts the fetus as a household member, making a pregnant woman alone a household of 2. This raises the income limit from $29,863 (138% FPL for household of 1) to $46,093 (213% FPL for household of 2) in 2026, which can mean the difference between qualifying and not qualifying.
items.es: Solicitar como hogar de 1 cuando el feto deberia contarse. Medicaid de Kentucky cuenta al feto como miembro del hogar, haciendo que una mujer embarazada sola sea un hogar de 2. Esto eleva el limite de ingresos de $29,863 a $46,093 en 2026, lo que puede significar la diferencia entre calificar y no calificar.

items.en: Waiting until late in pregnancy to apply. Kentucky Medicaid can be retroactive to the first day of the month you applied, and Kentucky's Presumptive Eligibility program means a prenatal clinic or hospital can start temporary Medicaid coverage within days. Delaying even one or two months can mean uncovered prenatal appointments, labs, and ultrasounds.
items.es: Esperar hasta tarde en el embarazo para solicitar. Medicaid de Kentucky puede ser retroactivo al primer dia del mes en que solicita, y el programa de Elegibilidad Presuntiva de Kentucky significa que una clinica prenatal u hospital puede iniciar cobertura temporal de Medicaid en dias. Retrasar incluso uno o dos meses puede significar citas prenatales, laboratorios y ecografias sin cobertura.

items.en: Missing the 60-day kynect Marketplace SEP for women above the Medicaid income limit. Pregnancy triggers a 60-day SEP to enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan. Submitting after Day 60 results in denial outside Open Enrollment. Medicaid is always available year-round, but the Marketplace SEP has a hard deadline.
items.es: Perder el SEP de 60 dias del mercado kynect para mujeres por encima del limite de ingresos de Medicaid. El embarazo activa un SEP de 60 dias para inscribirse en un plan del mercado kynect. Enviar despues del Dia 60 resulta en un rechazo fuera de la Inscripcion Abierta.

items.en: Not planning for the postpartum coverage transition before delivery. After Kentucky's 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension ends, standard Medicaid income rules at 138% FPL apply. Women whose income is between 138% and 213% FPL will lose Medicaid after postpartum. Plan to apply for a kynect Marketplace plan before postpartum Medicaid ends, using the loss-of-coverage SEP triggered by the Medicaid termination.
items.es: No planificar la transicion de cobertura postparto antes del parto. Despues de que termine la extension Medicaid postparto de 12 meses de Kentucky, se aplican las reglas estandar de Medicaid al 138% FPL. Las mujeres cuyos ingresos estan entre el 138% y el 213% FPL perderan Medicaid despues del postparto. Planifique solicitar un plan del mercado kynect antes de que termine Medicaid postparto.

items.en: Choosing a kynect Marketplace plan without verifying your Kentucky OB-GYN is in-network. Switching plans mid-pregnancy can disrupt your prenatal care continuity and generate surprise out-of-network bills for a provider you have already established care with.
items.es: Elegir un plan del mercado kynect sin verificar que su ginecoologo de Kentucky esta en la red. Cambiar de plan a mitad del embarazo puede interrumpir la continuidad de su atencion prenatal y generar facturas sorpresa fuera de red.

heading.en: Kentucky Medicaid Postpartum Coverage: 12 Months After Delivery in 2026
heading.es: Cobertura Postparto Medicaid de Kentucky: 12 Meses Despues del Parto en 2026

paragraphs.en: Kentucky adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension under the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021, with the extension made permanent by the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2023. This means any Kentucky woman who was enrolled in pregnancy Medicaid on the day of delivery continues to receive Medicaid coverage for 12 full months after birth, regardless of whether her income has changed during that period. The 12-month postpartum extension in Kentucky applies at the same income threshold that governed pregnancy coverage, not the stricter 138% FPL standard adult threshold. This is a critical distinction: a Kentucky woman who qualified for pregnancy Medicaid at 200% FPL continues to receive Medicaid for 12 months postpartum at that income level, even if she would not qualify for standard adult Kentucky Medicaid. Kentucky's postpartum extension matters for maternal health because maternal mortality in the United States remains elevated for the full first year after delivery. Postpartum access to blood pressure management, postpartum depression treatment, chronic condition care, and preventive services reduces this risk. Kentucky ranks among the states with above-average maternal mortality rates, making the 12-month postpartum extension especially impactful for women in the Commonwealth.
paragraphs.es: Kentucky adopto la extension Medicaid postparto de 12 meses bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano de 2021, con la extension hecha permanente por la Ley de Asignaciones Consolidadas de 2023. Esto significa que cualquier mujer de Kentucky que estaba inscrita en Medicaid de embarazo el dia del parto continua recibiendo cobertura de Medicaid durante 12 meses completos despues del nacimiento, independientemente de si sus ingresos han cambiado durante ese periodo. La extension postparto de 12 meses en Kentucky aplica al mismo umbral de ingresos que regulo la cobertura del embarazo, no el umbral estandar mas estricto del 138% FPL para adultos. La extension postparto de Kentucky es importante para la salud materna porque la mortalidad materna en los Estados Unidos permanece elevada durante el primer ano completo despues del parto. Kentucky se encuentra entre los estados con tasas de mortalidad materna superiores al promedio, lo que hace que la extension postparto de 12 meses sea especialmente impactante.

paragraphs.en: After the 12-month postpartum period ends, Kentucky reverts to standard adult Medicaid income rules: 138% FPL for expansion Medicaid, which equals $22,025 for a single adult in 2026. Women whose income is between 138% and 213% FPL will transition off Kentucky Medicaid when their postpartum period ends. The loss of Kentucky Medicaid is a qualifying life event that triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for kynect Marketplace plans. To avoid a coverage gap, apply to kynect.ky.gov for a Marketplace plan before your postpartum Medicaid termination date. The 2027 ACA Open Enrollment begins November 1, 2026, so women whose postpartum Medicaid ends in late 2026 should coordinate timing. Using the ACA income limits reference confirms whether premium tax credits are available at your income level for the kynect Marketplace plan.
paragraphs.es: Despues de que termine el periodo postparto de 12 meses, Kentucky revierte a las reglas estandar de ingresos de Medicaid para adultos: 138% FPL para Medicaid de expansion, que equivale a $22,025 para un adulto soltero en 2026. Las mujeres cuyos ingresos estan entre el 138% y el 213% FPL pasaran de Kentucky Medicaid cuando termine su periodo postparto. La perdida de Medicaid de Kentucky es un evento calificador de vida que activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del mercado kynect. Para evitar una brecha de cobertura, solicite en kynect.ky.gov un plan del Mercado antes de la fecha de terminacion de Medicaid postparto.

heading.en: kynect Marketplace for Pregnant Women in Kentucky: How the 60-Day SEP Works
heading.es: Mercado kynect para Mujeres Embarazadas en Kentucky: Como Funciona el SEP de 60 Dias

paragraphs.en: kynect is Kentucky's state-based marketplace for ACA-compliant health insurance plans. For pregnant Kentucky women whose income exceeds the 213% FPL pregnancy Medicaid threshold, kynect Marketplace is the primary path to coverage. Pregnancy is a qualifying life event under federal ACA rules, triggering a 60-day Special Enrollment Period that begins when you confirm pregnancy and runs 60 days from that date. For example, if you confirm pregnancy on June 14, 2026, your kynect Marketplace SEP window runs through August 13, 2026. Applications submitted after Day 60 are rejected outside Open Enrollment. All kynect Marketplace plans cover maternity care and prenatal services as essential health benefits. Preventive prenatal visits are covered at zero cost-sharing under the ACA preventive care mandate. The birth of your baby triggers a separate 60-day SEP to add the newborn to your kynect Marketplace plan. Coverage for the newborn is retroactive to the birth date once you complete the dependent addition.
paragraphs.es: kynect es el mercado basado en el estado de Kentucky para planes de seguro de salud conformes con el ACA. Para las mujeres embarazadas de Kentucky cuyos ingresos superan el umbral del 213% FPL de Medicaid de embarazo, el mercado kynect es la ruta principal a la cobertura. El embarazo es un evento calificador de vida bajo las reglas federales del ACA, activando un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias que comienza cuando confirma el embarazo. Por ejemplo, si confirma el embarazo el 14 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP del mercado kynect corre hasta el 13 de agosto de 2026. Todos los planes del mercado kynect cubren la atencion de maternidad y los servicios prenatales como beneficios esenciales de salud. El nacimiento de su bebe activa un SEP separado de 60 dias para agregar al recien nacido a su plan del mercado kynect.

paragraphs.en: Premium tax credits on kynect plans in 2026 apply for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff returned for the current plan year after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan and Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026, so incomes above 400% FPL face unsubsidized premiums. For most Kentucky families with incomes between 138% and 400% FPL who do not qualify for Medicaid, a Silver kynect plan costs $10 to $300 per month after premium tax credits. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 per individual and $21,200 per family (per the HHS 2026 NBPP revision). Form 1095-A from kynect will arrive in January 2027 and is needed to reconcile your Advanced Premium Tax Credit on IRS Form 8962. Report your baby's birth to kynect promptly to update your household size and income, which affects your premium tax credit calculation for the remainder of 2026.
paragraphs.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima en los planes kynect en 2026 aplican para ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL. El precipicio de subsidio ACA 2026 regreso para el ano del plan actual despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que los ingresos por encima del 400% FPL enfrentan primas no subsidiadas. Para la mayoria de las familias de Kentucky con ingresos entre el 138% y el 400% FPL que no califican para Medicaid, un plan Silver de kynect cuesta de $10 a $300 al mes despues de los creditos fiscales de prima. El maximo de gastos de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 por persona y $21,200 por familia. El Formulario 1095-A de kynect llegara en enero de 2027 y es necesario para reconciliar su Credito Fiscal de Prima Anticipado en el Formulario IRS 8962.

heading.en: KCHIP and Newborn Coverage in Kentucky: What Happens After Your Baby Is Born
heading.es: KCHIP y Cobertura del Recien Nacido en Kentucky: Que Sucede Despues del Nacimiento de Su Bebe

paragraphs.en: KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) is Kentucky's CHIP program, providing low-cost health coverage to children in Kentucky families who earn too much for Medicaid but still need affordable coverage. KCHIP covers children through age 18 in households typically earning up to 218% FPL. KCHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline, and Kentucky administers KCHIP through the same kynect.ky.gov portal as Medicaid. KCHIP covers well-child visits, dental and vision care, immunizations, and preventive services with low or no premiums and minimal cost-sharing. For a new baby, automatic Medicaid deemed enrollment applies if the mother was on Kentucky Medicaid on the date of delivery: the newborn is automatically eligible for Medicaid through the first birthday under the federal deemed newborn rule (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)), with no separate application required. After the baby's first birthday, automatic deemed Medicaid eligibility ends and the family must apply for KCHIP or regular Medicaid to continue children's coverage. Submit the renewal application before the child's first birthday to avoid a coverage gap.
paragraphs.es: KCHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos de Kentucky) es el programa CHIP de Kentucky, que proporciona cobertura de salud de bajo costo a los ninos en familias de Kentucky que ganan demasiado para Medicaid. KCHIP cubre a los ninos hasta los 18 anos en hogares que generalmente ganan hasta el 218% FPL. La inscripcion en KCHIP es todo el ano sin fecha limite, y Kentucky administra KCHIP a traves del mismo portal kynect.ky.gov que Medicaid. Para un nuevo bebe, se aplica la inscripcion automatica presunta de Medicaid si la madre estaba en Medicaid de Kentucky el dia del parto: el recien nacido es automaticamente elegible para Medicaid hasta el primer cumpleanos bajo la regla federal del recien nacido presunto (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). Despues del primer cumpleanos del bebe, la elegibilidad automatica de Medicaid termina y la familia debe solicitar KCHIP o Medicaid regular para continuar la cobertura de los ninos.

en.question: What is the income limit for pregnancy Medicaid in Kentucky in 2026?
en.answer: Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers incomes up to 213% of the Federal Poverty Level in 2026. For a single pregnant woman, that equals approximately $33,995 per year. For a household of 2 (pregnant woman plus partner), the limit is approximately $46,093 per year. For a family of 4, the limit is approximately $70,290 per year. Kentucky also counts the unborn child as a household member for Medicaid eligibility purposes, which raises your household size by 1 and further increases the income threshold in your favor. Verify your exact eligibility at kynect.ky.gov or by calling 1-855-459-6328.

en.question: How do I apply for pregnancy Medicaid in Kentucky?
en.answer: Apply for Kentucky pregnancy Medicaid at kynect.ky.gov, Kentucky's integrated benefits portal. You can also call 1-855-459-6328 or visit your local Department for Community Based Services (DCBS) office. Kentucky Medicaid enrollment for pregnant women is year-round with no deadline. The application asks about your income, household size (including the unborn child), residency, and citizenship or immigration status. Gather a letter from your doctor or midwife confirming pregnancy, proof of income (recent pay stubs), proof of Kentucky residency, and your Social Security number before applying. Ask about Presumptive Eligibility: a prenatal clinic or hospital can authorize temporary Medicaid coverage within days while your full application is reviewed.

en.question: Does Kentucky Medicaid cover the full cost of delivery?
en.answer: Yes. Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers labor and delivery with zero premiums, zero deductibles, and zero cost-sharing in most cases, including hospital delivery, cesarean sections, anesthesia, and newborn care in the delivery hospitalization. This is a major financial advantage over kynect Marketplace plans, which carry an out-of-pocket maximum of up to $10,600 per individual in 2026. Even with a subsidized kynect plan, a hospital birth can result in hundreds to thousands of dollars of out-of-pocket costs. Kentucky Medicaid eliminates this exposure for eligible pregnant women.

en.question: How long does Kentucky postpartum Medicaid last after the baby is born?
en.answer: Kentucky adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension under the American Rescue Plan Act. Any Kentucky woman enrolled in pregnancy Medicaid on the day of delivery continues to receive Medicaid for 12 full months after birth. After the 12-month postpartum period ends, standard Kentucky Medicaid income rules apply at 138% FPL. Women whose income is between 138% and 213% FPL will lose Medicaid after the postpartum period. That loss of coverage triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for kynect Marketplace plans at kynect.ky.gov, so plan ahead to avoid a gap.

en.question: Does having a baby qualify me for a Special Enrollment Period on kynect in Kentucky?
en.answer: Yes. Both confirming pregnancy and the birth of your baby are qualifying life events that each trigger a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for kynect Marketplace plans. Pregnancy triggers the first SEP: if you confirm pregnancy on June 14, 2026, your kynect SEP window runs through August 13, 2026. The birth of your baby triggers a second 60-day SEP to add the newborn as a dependent. Marketplace coverage for the newborn is retroactive to the birth date once you complete the dependent addition. Medicaid enrollment at kynect.ky.gov remains year-round with no SEP deadline.

en.question: What happens to my baby's coverage after birth in Kentucky?
en.answer: If you are enrolled in Kentucky Medicaid on the day of delivery, your newborn is automatically deemed eligible for Medicaid through the first birthday under the federal deemed newborn rule (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No separate application is required for the baby. Notify the Cabinet for Health and Family Services (CHFS) at kynect.ky.gov with the baby's name and birth date within 60 days. After the first birthday, KCHIP covers children in Kentucky households earning up to 218% FPL, with year-round enrollment and no deadline. If you are on a kynect Marketplace plan, the newborn is NOT automatically covered: you must add the baby within 60 days of birth.

en.question: What state-specific rules apply to pregnancy coverage in Kentucky?
en.answer: Kentucky-specific rules in 2026 include: (1) 213% FPL income limit for pregnancy Medicaid, higher than the standard 138% FPL expansion limit; (2) 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension in effect; (3) Presumptive Eligibility program, allowing hospitals and prenatal clinics to grant temporary Medicaid coverage within days; (4) KCHIP covers children in Kentucky at up to 218% FPL with year-round enrollment; (5) kynect is Kentucky's state-based Marketplace for ACA plans, accessible at kynect.ky.gov, with pregnancy as a qualifying life event for a 60-day SEP. Kentucky is a full Medicaid expansion state, meaning adults up to 138% FPL also qualify for standard Kentucky Medicaid independently.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it during pregnancy in Kentucky?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the best option for pregnant women in Kentucky because Kentucky Medicaid for pregnant women covers incomes up to 213% FPL at zero cost, and kynect Marketplace plans with subsidies cost $10 to $300 per month for most Kentucky families. COBRA charges 102% of the full employer premium, typically $700 to $2,000 per month for an individual. The one case where COBRA makes sense during pregnancy in Kentucky: you are mid-pregnancy with a specific OB-GYN or maternal-fetal medicine specialist who is not in any kynect Marketplace network, and you have already met your annual deductible. In all other cases, check Kentucky Medicaid first, then kynect Marketplace, then COBRA as a last resort.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos para Medicaid de embarazo en Kentucky en 2026?
es.answer: Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas cubre ingresos hasta el 213% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza en 2026. Para una mujer embarazada sola, eso equivale a aproximadamente $33,995 por ano. Para un hogar de 2 (mujer embarazada mas pareja), el limite es aproximadamente $46,093 por ano. Para una familia de 4, el limite es aproximadamente $70,290 por ano. Kentucky tambien cuenta al feto como miembro del hogar para propositos de elegibilidad de Medicaid, lo que aumenta el tamano de su hogar en 1 y eleva aun mas el umbral de ingresos. Verifique su elegibilidad exacta en kynect.ky.gov o llamando al 1-855-459-6328.

es.question: Como solicito Medicaid de embarazo en Kentucky?
es.answer: Solicite Medicaid de embarazo de Kentucky en kynect.ky.gov, el portal integrado de beneficios de Kentucky. Tambien puede llamar al 1-855-459-6328 o visitar su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Comunitarios (DCBS). La inscripcion en Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Reuna una carta de su medico o partera que confirme el embarazo, prueba de ingresos (talones de pago recientes), prueba de residencia en Kentucky y su numero de Seguro Social antes de solicitar. Pregunte sobre la Elegibilidad Presuntiva: una clinica prenatal u hospital puede autorizar cobertura temporal de Medicaid en dias mientras se revisa su solicitud completa.

es.question: Medicaid de Kentucky cubre el costo total del parto?
es.answer: Si. Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas cubre el parto con cero primas, cero deducibles y cero costos compartidos en la mayoria de los casos, incluyendo parto hospitalario, cesareas, anestesia y atencion del recien nacido en la hospitalizacion del parto. Esta es una ventaja financiera importante sobre los planes del mercado kynect, que tienen un maximo de gastos de bolsillo de hasta $10,600 por persona en 2026. Incluso con un plan kynect subsidiado, un parto hospitalario puede resultar en cientos o miles de dolares de costos de bolsillo. Medicaid de Kentucky elimina esta exposicion para las mujeres embarazadas elegibles.

es.question: Cuanto dura Medicaid postparto de Kentucky despues del nacimiento del bebe?
es.answer: Kentucky adopto la extension Medicaid postparto de 12 meses bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano. Cualquier mujer de Kentucky inscrita en Medicaid de embarazo el dia del parto continua recibiendo Medicaid durante 12 meses completos despues del nacimiento. Despues de que termine el periodo postparto de 12 meses, se aplican las reglas estandar de Medicaid de Kentucky al 138% FPL. Las mujeres cuyos ingresos estan entre el 138% y el 213% FPL perderan Medicaid despues del periodo postparto. Esa perdida de cobertura activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del mercado kynect en kynect.ky.gov.

es.question: Tener un bebe me da derecho a un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial en kynect de Kentucky?
es.answer: Si. Tanto confirmar el embarazo como el nacimiento de su bebe son eventos calificadores de vida que cada uno activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del mercado kynect. El embarazo activa el primer SEP: si confirma el embarazo el 14 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP de kynect corre hasta el 13 de agosto de 2026. El nacimiento de su bebe activa un segundo SEP de 60 dias para agregar al recien nacido como dependiente. La cobertura del mercado para el recien nacido es retroactiva a la fecha de nacimiento una vez que complete la adicion del dependiente.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mi bebe despues del nacimiento en Kentucky?
es.answer: Si esta inscrita en Medicaid de Kentucky el dia del parto, su recien nacido es automaticamente considerado elegible para Medicaid hasta el primer cumpleanos bajo la regla federal del recien nacido presunto (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No se requiere solicitud separada. Notifique al Gabinete de Salud y Servicios Familiares (CHFS) en kynect.ky.gov con el nombre y fecha de nacimiento del bebe dentro de 60 dias. Despues del primer cumpleanos, KCHIP cubre a los ninos en hogares de Kentucky que ganan hasta el 218% FPL, con inscripcion todo el ano sin fecha limite. Si esta en un plan del mercado kynect, el recien nacido NO esta automaticamente cubierto: debe agregar al bebe dentro de 60 dias del nacimiento.

es.question: Que reglas especificas del estado aplican a la cobertura de embarazo en Kentucky?
es.answer: Las reglas especificas de Kentucky en 2026 incluyen: (1) limite de ingresos del 213% FPL para Medicaid de embarazo, superior al limite estandar de expansion del 138% FPL; (2) extension postparto de Medicaid de 12 meses vigente; (3) programa de Elegibilidad Presuntiva, que permite a hospitales y clinicas prenatales otorgar cobertura temporal de Medicaid en dias; (4) KCHIP cubre a los ninos en Kentucky hasta el 218% FPL con inscripcion todo el ano; (5) kynect es el mercado basado en el estado de Kentucky para planes ACA, accesible en kynect.ky.gov, con el embarazo como evento calificador de vida para un SEP de 60 dias. Kentucky es un estado de expansion completa de Medicaid.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA durante el embarazo en Kentucky?
es.answer: COBRA rara vez es la mejor opcion para las mujeres embarazadas en Kentucky porque Medicaid de Kentucky para mujeres embarazadas cubre ingresos hasta el 213% FPL sin costo, y los planes del mercado kynect con subsidios cuestan de $10 a $300 al mes para la mayoria de las familias de Kentucky. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa del empleador, tipicamente $700 a $2,000 al mes para una persona. El caso donde COBRA tiene sentido durante el embarazo en Kentucky: esta a mitad del embarazo con un ginecologo especifico que no esta en ninguna red del mercado kynect, y ya cumplio su deducible anual. En todos los demas casos, verifique Medicaid de Kentucky primero, luego el mercado kynect, luego COBRA como ultimo recurso.

note.en: Federal ACA rules on pregnancy and birth as qualifying life events, 60-day SEP window, and Marketplace enrollment process applicable to kynect Kentucky.
note.es: Reglas federales ACA sobre el embarazo y el parto como eventos calificadores de vida, ventana SEP de 60 dias y proceso de inscripcion en el Mercado aplicable a kynect Kentucky.

note.en: 2026 Federal Poverty Level figures used to calculate all Medicaid and ACA subsidy income thresholds on this page, including Kentucky's 213% FPL pregnancy limit.
note.es: Cifras del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 utilizadas para calcular todos los umbrales de ingresos de Medicaid y subsidios ACA en esta pagina, incluyendo el limite de embarazo del 213% FPL de Kentucky.
